title: The US is not a democracy but an oligarchy, study concludes (2014)
summary: A 2014 UPI article reporting on academic research that concluded the United States functions more as an oligarchy than a democracy, based on studies showing economic elites have disproportionate influence on government policy decisions.
problem_solved: This article informs readers about research findings on the disparity between public opinion and actual policy outcomes in the US political system.
why_valuable: It provides access to peer-reviewed political science research on money's influence in politics, contributing to public understanding of democratic representation.
